title: Photo
description: Represents a single image discovered and downloaded by the ScraperService from a target website. Created automatically during a ScrapeJob; metadata fields are pre-populated by the scraper and may be edited by users before inclusion in an OnboardingRequest.

id.description: Unique identifier for this photo record.

scrappedResultId.description: FK → scrapped_results.id. The parent scrape job that discovered this photo.

onboardingRequestId.description: FK → onboarding_requests.id. Populated once this photo is added to an OnboardingRequest. Null if not yet included.

photoFileId.description: The object key / path in object storage (S3 or R2) where the downloaded image file is saved. Set by the scraper after successful download.

sourceUrl.description: The direct URL of the image file on the scraped website.

sourcePageUrl.description: The URL of the page on the target website where this image was found. Used for attribution and deduplication.

source.description: Human-readable name of the source institution or website.
source.example: Library of Congress — Civil War Photographs

name.description: Name or title of the photo, typically the person's name if a portrait. Auto-extracted from page metadata if available; editable by users.

regiment.description: Military regiment or unit associated with the subject of the photo. Auto-extracted if available.

age.description: Age of the subject at the time the photo was taken. Stored as a string to accommodate ranges or approximate values (e.g. '22', 'c.18-20').

dateTaken.description: Date or partial date when the photo was taken. Accepts YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD to preserve original precision. Prefix with 'c.' for circa dates.

location.description: Geographic location where the photo was taken.

photographer.description: Name of the photographer or studio that took the photo.

collection.description: Name of the archive collection this photo belongs to within the source institution.

photoNotes.description: Freeform descriptive notes about the photo. Auto-extracted from alt text, captions, or page descriptions; editable by users.
photoNotes.example: Half-length portrait of soldier seated, facing slightly left, wearing uniform and holding musket.

tags.description: Searchable keyword tags. Auto-generated by the scraper from page metadata; users may add, remove, or edit tags before onboarding.

license.description: Copyright or usage license for this image as found on the source page.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the downloaded image file, set by the scraper upon download.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the downloaded image file in bytes. Set by the scraper after download.

widthPx.description: Width of the image in pixels. Set by the scraper after download.

heightPx.description: Height of the image in pixels. Set by the scraper after download.

isDuplicate.description: True if the scraper's deduplication check determined this image already exists in the platform or within the same scrape batch. Duplicate photos can still be reviewed but will be flagged.

duplicateOfId.description: If isDuplicate is true, the id of the existing Photo record this image duplicates. Null otherwise.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the photo through the ingestion pipeline.

isAutoExtracted.description: True if all metadata fields were populated solely by the scraper. Set to false once a user edits any metadata field.

metadataEditedBy.description: FK → users.id. The last user who edited metadata fields on this photo. Null if no user edits have been made.

metadataEditedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent user metadata edit. Null if no edits have been made.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this photo record was created by the scraper.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field on this record.

examples.$comment: Example 1: Freshly scraped photo — metadata auto-extracted, not yet reviewed
examples.source: Library of Congress — Civil War Photographs
examples.name: Unidentified soldier in Union uniform
examples.photoNotes: Half-length portrait of soldier seated, facing slightly left, wearing uniform and holding musket.

examples.$comment: Example 2: Photo reviewed and edited by a user, included in an onboarding request
examples.source: Library of Congress — Civil War Photographs
examples.name: Sergeant William H. Carney, 54th Massachusetts Infantry
examples.photoNotes: Portrait of Sgt. William Carney, first African American to earn the Medal of Honor. Shown in uniform, standing.
